verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm a SIP interconnect feature that connects Video API sessions to SIP gateways, a documented telephony bridge. The evidence is a single sentence, though, and does not describe how phone callers dial in or how the session dials out. missing for 10: documented PSTN dial-in flow, documented dial-out to phone numbers, SIP interconnect API/guide detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, phone callers join a session through documented SIP or PSTN dial-in and dial-out

citations.quote: The Media Router supports the SIP interconnect feature, which lets you connect sessions to SIP gateways.
